role: CI gate: `String(format:` calls with float specifiers (and no integer specifiers) in Views/, Export/ and named narrative generators must pass `locale:`.
toplevel: cd to repo root. SCAN_DIRS Views and Export (missing -> 2); SCAN_FILES CitationQuickView.swift, SessionStorageDiagnostic.swift, AnalysisSummaryGenerator*.swift, CoachReportGenerator*.swift, ScoreDetailBuilder.swift, MorningResultsViewModel.swift, Assistant/WorkoutTriggerEngine*.swift (missing -> 2). Calls scan_violations with the dirs and files inside "$(…)" (the Python is in that function, not a here-document inside the substitution, so macOS bash 3.2 parses it): over whole file text: every `String(format: "...",` (may span lines); skipped if its first line is a // comment or carries debugLog/NSLog/os_log, or if `locale:` appears inside that call's own parentheses (string-aware paren match); float and not int specifier -> violation. Python failure -> exit 2. Violations -> exit 1; else clean. Clean on the current tree. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.

units.does: Runs the embedded Python scan over the directories and files passed as arguments and prints one line per user-facing String(format:) call that formats a decimal (float specifier, no integer specifier) without passing locale:. Its exit status is the Python's.
units.entry: Called once from the script's top level inside VIOLATIONS="$(…)".

branches.effect: non-zero exit; the caller reports the scan failed (exit 2)
